cd /workspace/tmp && rm -rf compiler && mkdir -p compiler && python3 - <<'PY'
import tarfile, os
t = tarfile.open('/workspace/toolchain/toolchain.tar.gz')
dest = '/workspace/tmp/compiler'
for m in t.getmembers():
    parts = m.name.split('/')
    if not m.isfile(): continue
    p = os.path.join(dest, *parts[2:])
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with t.extractfile(m) as src, open(p,'wb') as dst:
        dst.write(src.read())
    os.chmod(p, 0o755 if m.mode & 0o111 else 0o644)
print('extracted')
PY
head -40 compiler/cxx.py
